settings.label: Size option names
settings.info: Comma-separated. The first product option matching one of these names is shown as size pills.

settings.label: Color option names
settings.info: Comma-separated. Shown as swatches using Shopify's native swatch colors.

settings.label: Option name and value translations
settings.info: One per line: Original = Romanian. Translates option names and values (Size, Color, Black…) wherever they are shown: filters, product options, cart and wishlist. The product data itself is unchanged.
